history.summary: Sri Hanuman Mandir Pandupol, Civil Lines, Gurugram - opposite Shama Tourist Complex on Jharsa Road, Civil Lines, Gurgaon 122001. Listed by JustDial with a 5.0 rating (522 ratings), year of establishment 2001. NAME NOTE: the famous 'Pandupol' Hanuman Mandir is the ancient shrine at Sariska, Alwar (Rajasthan); this Gurgaon temple shares the name, and whether it is a branch or namesake is unverified - flag for confirmation. Another older Hanuman shrine exists at Ramlila Ground, Sadar Bazar Rd, Roshan Pura (listed among Civil Lines temples), but the Pandupol one is the best-documented 'Hanuman Mandir, Civil Lines' match. Hours note: JustDial's directory hours are 6:00 AM - 12:00 PM daily; a search-result snippet mentions opening at 5:00 PM, likely evening darshan - evening hours not published (verify locally).
